summary: A continuous row of oval-cut diamonds in smooth bezel settings, with 10.00 ct total diamond weight and a secure clasp with safety closures.
description:
A modern take on the classic tennis bracelet, designed with a continuous row of luminous oval-cut diamonds, each individually framed in a smooth bezel setting.

The bezel design gives the bracelet a stronger gold presence while keeping every diamond securely enclosed, creating a clean, substantial look with beautiful brilliance from every angle. With 10 carats total diamond weight, it has noticeable presence on the wrist without losing its refined feel. Finished with a secure clasp and safety closures, it is designed for both statement wear and everyday luxury.
care: Store flat and separately, and clean gently around each bezel setting.
shipping: Availability, bracelet length and delivery timing are confirmed during inquiry.
